findings.title: No OpenGraph tags on homepage
findings.evidence: og:title, og:description, og:image all absent from homepage.

suggested_action.summary: Add og:title, og:description, og:image, og:type to every page template.

findings.title: Statistics without source citations on /
findings.evidence: 3 uncited stats, 0 cited. Princeton KDD 2024: sourced stats → +40% AI citation.

suggested_action.summary: Add source links or parenthetical citations to every statistic.

findings.title: No author bylines detected on homepage
findings.evidence: author_count=0, has_person_schema=False. No bylines, bio sections, or author credential markup.

suggested_action.summary: Add named author bylines + Person schema to blog and editorial content.

findings.title: No RSL 1.0 machine-readable license declaration
findings.evidence: /.well-known/rsl.json returns 404 and no <link rel='robots-standard-license'> in HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Deploy /.well-known/rsl.json with RSL 1.0 to declare content reuse terms for AI crawlers.

findings.title: Zero AI discovery endpoints present (0/14 checked)
findings.evidence: None of 14 AI discovery endpoints return HTTP 200.

suggested_action.summary: Deploy /.well-known/ai.txt and /ai/summary.json as minimum viable AI discovery.

findings.title: Low question-format heading ratio (4%) on /
findings.evidence: 4/104 H2/H3s are questions. Sample: ['do it all in less time.', 'do it all in less time.']

suggested_action.summary: Rewrite key H2 headings as questions to improve FAQ schema eligibility and AI direct-answer targeting.

findings.title: No FAQ section on /
findings.evidence: has_faq_section=False, estimated_qa_pairs=0.

suggested_action.summary: Add FAQ section + FAQPage schema.

findings.title: No content freshness date marker on /
findings.evidence: No visible 'As of [date]' or 'Last updated' text marker found.

suggested_action.summary: Add 'Last updated: [Month Year]' visible text. Freshness is top Perplexity ranking signal.

findings.title: Low answer-capsule ratio (20%) on /
findings.evidence: 1/5 H2/H3 sections have a 40+ word direct answer capsule. ChatGPT citation correlation: 72.4% of cited pages have ≥50%.

suggested_action.summary: Add a direct 40–60 word answer paragraph immediately after each major H2/H3 heading.

findings.title: No review platform links from homepage
findings.evidence: No G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, or other review platform links detected.

suggested_action.summary: Add G2/Trustpilot badges. SE Ranking 2026: review links → 3× citation probability.

findings.title: Social profile links absent from homepage HTML
findings.evidence: No LinkedIn company, Twitter/X, or YouTube links detected in homepage HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Add visible social links in footer HTML matching the sameAs JSON-LD values.

findings.title: No original research or proprietary data signals
findings.evidence: No 'our study', 'we surveyed', 'n=X respondents' signals found.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an original study or benchmark. Original research is the highest-value citation magnet.

findings.title: No privacy policy link detectable on homepage
findings.evidence: Privacy policy link pattern not found in homepage HTML.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible Privacy Policy link to the homepage footer.

findings.title: 6 images missing alt text
findings.evidence: Images without alt attributes: ./media_15d0c67d468c6ab860bd67d3af2d0998c15f45bbc.webp?width=750&format=web, ./media_180a8327664c8013005414b32d539cb95ce16ef7a.webp?width=750&format=web, ./media_13dac5079e7f5c35eb785e3e282b020d3859f4c5a.webp?width=750&format=web...

suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to all images. Alt text is an AI-indexable content signal.

findings.title: No RSS/Atom feed found
findings.evidence: Checked /feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /feed.xml — all returned non-200.

suggested_action.summary: Create an RSS/Atom feed. Perplexity and AI news agents index feeds for freshness.

findings.title: No Speakable schema
findings.evidence: site_has_speakable=False. No SpeakableSpecification markup found.

suggested_action.summary: Add Speakable schema to product descriptions and key content sections.

findings.title: No FAQPage schema
findings.evidence: site_has_faqpage=False.

suggested_action.summary: Add FAQPage + Question + Answer schema to key landing pages.

findings.title: No key-takeaway / TL;DR box on /
findings.evidence: No TL;DR, summary, or key-highlight block detected.

suggested_action.summary: Add a 'Key highlights' box near top of content pages.

findings.title: No Twitter Card meta tags
findings.evidence: No twitter:card, twitter:title, or twitter:description found.

suggested_action.summary: Add twitter:card=summary_large_image and twitter:title/description.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt companion file
findings.evidence: /llms-full.txt returns 404.

suggested_action.summary: Create /llms-full.txt with complete product documentation for LLM ingestion.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.evidence: No IndexNow key found in HTML or robots.txt.

suggested_action.summary: Implement IndexNow to notify Bing/Perplexity on publish.
